title: The wrong order
starting_code:
# This program does things in the wrong order!
door.open()
wizard.move_left(5)
hints: A door only listens to whoever stands right beside it.
Move the lines around so your wizard takes the steps first.
The computer runs the lines from the top down, so the move method must come before the open method.
intro: Here is your key back. My old program takes it to Eldra's little room, but it does things in the wrong order! It asks the door to open from where it starts, and only then walks to it. A door only listens to whoever stands beside it. Can you fix it?
outro: Much better! The door is open, and you are ready to go in.
learned: Now you know that the computer does the steps from the top down, and that a step in the wrong place does nothing.
